A '''camouflage net''', also known as a '''camo net''' or '''camo-netting''', was a piece of equipment used for concealment.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /><ref name="COURTSHIP">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Camouflage netting was an advanced netting that incorporated both light-bending technology and metallic thread jammers, concealing objects under the netting both visually and from [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> Camouflage netting came in a small backpack, and a single individual could fully deploy the netting in about a minute; once deployed, an internal [[power cell]] could power the netting for a full month before needing a recharge.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> On activation, camouflage netting would alter its pattern, smoothing and blending into surrounding terrain.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> Other types of nets had a photosensitive surface that could capture, then display, an image - a user would spread such a net on the ground and photograph it before deploying the net.<ref name="COURTSHIP" />
